universe: resolved Polymarket soccer moneyline events (home/draw/away YES markets) with gameStartTime in the 60 days before 2026-10-21, in leagues covered by football-data.co.uk 2026/27 CSVs
matching: same kickoff date (UTC date of gameStartTime vs CSV Date, +/-1 day allowed for time-zone) AND both team names fuzzy-matched (normalised tokens, alias table, similarity >= 0.6 each); games with more than one candidate match are DROPPED (no guessing); the Polymarket market for each outcome identified by groupItemTitle/question (home team, away team, draw)

sharp_reference.primary: football-data 'BFEH/BFED/BFEA' = Betfair Exchange pre-match odds (football-data collects pre-match odds on Fridays/Tuesdays, i.e. BEFORE kickoff -> no look-ahead). The 2026/27 CSVs contain no Pinnacle columns.
sharp_reference.fallback: if BFE missing: AvgH/AvgD/AvgA (market average) - reported separately
sharp_reference.diagnostic_only: closing odds BFECH/BFECD/BFECA are LOOK-AHEAD relative to a T-1h entry and are reported only as a diagnostic, never as the strategy result

strategy.price_proxy: last CLOB /prices-history point (fidelity 10) at or before decision time for that outcome's YES token
strategy.fee: shares * rate * p * (1-p) from the market feeSchedule (default 0.05)
